 'Abbott Elementary' cast says the city of Philadelphia is the true star of the show 
 Our favorite characters from 'Abbott Elementary' are back for Season 6, and so is the one the cast says is truly the star of the show: the city of Ph WPVI By Alicia Vitarelli Wednesday, October 7, 2026 Share PHILADELPHIA (WPVI) -- Our favorite characters from ABC's hit sitcom "Abbott Elementary" are back for Season 6, and so is the one the cast says is truly the star of the show: the city of Philadelphia.
 Alicia Vitarelli sits down with the show's stars to talk inspiration, heart, grit and Philly humor.
 Season 6 of "Abbott Elementary" airs Wednesday, October 7 on ABC.
